image_description: A close-up shot of a woman's upper chest and neck wearing a chunky, artistic necklace. The necklace features large white spherical beads, dark brown fabric rosettes or bows, and a central pendant composed of layered dark brown and yellow petal-like structures resembling a flower. The chain appears to be a mix of metal links and possibly cord, connecting the decorative elements.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow petals at the bottom of the central pendant have a slightly smooth, plastic-like texture that lacks the fine micro-detail expected of real fabric or organic material, appearing slightly 'melted' into the brown layers above.

artifact_observations.location: Connection points between beads and metal links
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection between the white beads and the metal links is ambiguous. In some areas, the metal seems to merge directly into the bead surface without a clear hole or loop, suggesting slight geometric fusion typical of AI generation.
Slight unnatural softness/blur at the boundary between the necklace and the skin, potentially indicating edge bleeding, though it could also be depth-of-field effect.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and not misidentified as other body adornments or clothing accessories.
To verify the physical connectivity of the chain links and ensure beads are properly strung/attached without floating or merging artifacts.
To assess the realism of materials (metal reflectivity, fabric texture) and detect subtle generative artifacts in the complex composite object.
To ensure the necklace sits correctly on the skin surface with proper occlusion and no background bleeding.

focus_areas: Connectivity of metal links to beads (checking for fusion)
Texture realism of the central flower pendant (fabric vs plastic look)
Specular highlights on metal components (consistency with lighting)
Edge sharpness between necklace and skin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' severity at the bead-link interfaces. AI often struggles with small mechanical connections like jump rings. Also, evaluate if the 'flower' pendant looks like constructed fabric or if it has an organic, melted appearance which would indicate a generation failure in material rendering.
